defect.reproducer: Change only lidar_joint parent from base_link to camera_link while retaining the 0.28 0 0.38 offset. check_urdf passes; tf2_echo base_link lidar_link reports [0.560, 0.000, 0.760]. test_lidar_parent fails. See defect/model-check.txt and regression-before.txt.
defect.root_cause: The offset intended relative to base_link is interpreted in camera_link. Composing the camera and lidar offsets doubles x and z. The tree is structurally valid, so only semantic geometry and expected-parent checks detect this error.
defect.proof_after: The main branch keeps lidar_joint directly under base_link. The same parent test passes, real tf2_echo returns [0.280, 0.000, 0.380], all 24 model tests pass, and RViz shows the complete model. See model-check.txt, regression-after.txt, frames.pdf and rviz.png.
